title: The Friday earnings report
hook: Would the same news receive the same immediate reaction on Friday?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate the timing of attention from the direction of the earnings information.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate the timing of attention from the direction of the earnings information.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy price response is thirty units immediately and seventy later. What is the total response across both windows? Toy inputs A=[30, 70]; B=[60, 40].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[30, 70, 100], [60, 40, 100]]. Labels: Immediate, Later, Total.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: A delayed reaction can differ from the immediate reaction without changing the total supplied information response. The two timing paths expose that distinction. No real-market abnormal return is verified by this toy decomposition.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Immediate reaction=60, Later reaction=40. What is Total? Answer: 100.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Immediate reaction=60, Later reaction=40. What is Total?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 100. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Earnings announced on Fridays get a weaker immediate reaction and more later drift (DellaVigna & Pollet, 2009).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate the timing of attention from the direction of the earnings information.
